id: 04_Lesson 7 How to Extend the Lifespan of MetalFab
title: 激光焊机与切割机的维护保养
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/04_Lesson 7 How to Extend the Lifespan of MetalFab.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/04_Lesson 7 How to Extend the Lifespan of MetalFab/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机和切割机旁，手拿一块无尘布，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a handheld laser welder and an enclosed cutting machine, holding a lint-free cloth, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：激光焊机和切割机怎么保养。
overlay: 激光焊机与切割机的维护保养

shots.scene: 镜片、焊丝盘、风扇、扫帚四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a round lens, a wire spool, a fan and a small brush. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片、焊丝、机内清洁，一样样来。

shots.scene: 阿杰焊接时火花很弱，皱眉看焊接头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in protective gear looks puzzled at a weak spark from the handheld welding head.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，焊接火花越来越弱。

shots.scene: 切割机底板里堆满熔渣，栅条上结满疙瘩
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cutting machine, the base tray is full of slag and the slats are crusted with lumps. No people.
shots.narration: 切割机里也积满了熔渣和灰尘。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白维护记录本走过来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over holding a blank maintenance logbook and a toolbox.
shots.narration: 老李说：该做一次全面保养了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 保养做得好，设备寿命长、也更安全。

shots.scene: 两个空白章节卡：焊机保养、切割机清洁
shots.prompt_en: Two blank chapter cards: one with a welding gun icon and one with a cutting machine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先保养焊机，再清洁切割机。

shots.scene: 功率条下降、火花变小的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a power bar dropping and a spark becoming small and weak. No people.
shots.narration: 功率下降、火花变弱，先查保护镜片。

shots.scene: 干净整洁的台面，空气中没有灰尘
shots.prompt_en: A clean, tidy workbench in a bright room with a dust-free sign on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 换镜片要在洁净的地方做。

shots.scene: 小研用无尘布擦拭焊接头外部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the outside of the handheld welding head with a lint-free cloth.
shots.narration: 先用无尘布把焊接头擦干净。

shots.scene: 小研洗手后戴上蓝色无尘手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands and puts on blue lint-free gloves.
shots.narration: 洗手，或戴上无尘手套。

shots.scene: 拆下顶盖，取出圆形镜片座
shots.prompt_en: Close view of blue-gloved hands removing the small top cover of the welding head and pulling out a round lens holder.
shots.narration: 拆开顶盖，取出镜片检查。

shots.scene: 棉签蘸酒精轻擦镜片
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a cotton swab dipped in alcohol gently wiping a round lens held by blue-gloved fingers.
shots.narration: 只是脏了，棉签蘸酒精擦净装回。

shots.scene: 烧出黑点的镜片旁边一个替换箭头
shots.prompt_en: A lens with a burnt dark spot and a replace arrow pointing to a new clean lens. No people.
shots.narration: 烧伤或擦不净，就要换新。

shots.scene: 取下密封圈和旧镜片
shots.prompt_en: Close view of blue-gloved hands removing a thin ring gasket and the old lens from the holder.
shots.narration: 取下密封圈和旧镜片。

shots.scene: 手指直接碰镜面的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bare fingertip touching a lens surface, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 新镜片的镜面，手指工具都别碰。

shots.scene: 镜片翻面的图标，两面都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a round lens flipping over, with a green check on both sides. No people.
shots.narration: 这种镜片正反两面都能用。

shots.scene: 撕掉保护膜装入，装回密封圈
shots.prompt_en: Close view of blue-gloved hands peeling thin film from the lens, setting it into the holder and fitting the gasket back.
shots.narration: 撕膜装入，装好密封圈。

shots.scene: 镜片座按方向压回焊接头
shots.prompt_en: The lens holder is pressed back into the welding head in the correct direction, shown by an arrow. No people besides gloved hands.
shots.narration: 按正确方向压回焊接头。

shots.scene: 红点偏在焊丝一侧，左右箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a red dot sitting beside a welding wire tip, with left and right arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 嘴装好了红光还偏，做左右校准。

shots.scene: 老李站在触摸屏前，屏上锁形图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands at the welder touchscreen, which shows a padlock icon and a blank keypad.
shots.narration: 在管理员设置里，由负责人操作。

shots.scene: 手指点左右箭头，红点移到焊丝上
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps left and right arrow buttons on the touchscreen; the red dot moves onto the wire tip. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 红光中心落到焊丝上，点完成。

shots.scene: 切割嘴剖面：光束打到内壁反射
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of a slim cutting nozzle with a beam striking the inner wall and bouncing back, with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 切割嘴堵光反光，先做左右校准。

shots.scene: 偏移值归零，内六角插进小孔慢慢拧
shots.prompt_en: A value box resets to zero on the screen, then a tiny hex key turns slowly in a hole on the welding head.
shots.narration: 不行就归零，用内六角慢慢调。

shots.scene: 红点变清晰，旁边两个大孔喷嘴打勾
shots.prompt_en: A red dot becomes sharp and clear; beside it a welding nozzle and a cleaning nozzle with wide openings get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 出现清晰红点就停；大孔嘴不用调。

shots.scene: 细丝盘箭头指向粗丝盘，下方三个配件图标
shots.prompt_en: A thin wire spool with an arrow to a thicker spool, and below them icons of a drive roll, a nozzle and a spool. No people.
shots.narration: 换粗一号的焊丝，配件跟着换。

shots.scene: 打开压紧器，倒转丝盘退丝，丝头卡进小孔
shots.prompt_en: Hands open the tension levers, turn the spool backward to pull the wire out, and tuck the wire end into a hole on the spool rim.
shots.narration: 退出焊丝，丝头卡进丝盘小孔。

shots.scene: 换上外侧规格与丝径一致的送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a drive roll with a magnified blank size marking being fitted; the old pair is stored above the drive unit.
shots.narration: 换上规格一致的送丝轮。

shots.scene: 送丝嘴换成大号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands screwing a larger copper nozzle onto the wire feeding tube.
shots.narration: 送丝嘴也换成大号。

shots.scene: 装新丝盘，戴手套剪丝头，穿丝
shots.prompt_en: Hands mount a new spool, a gloved hand trims the bent wire end with cutters, and the wire is threaded into the drive unit.
shots.narration: 装新丝盘，剪弯头，穿丝。

shots.scene: 调张力，按住送丝键直到出丝
shots.prompt_en: Tension knobs are turned beside a blank table; a finger holds the feed button until the wire comes out of the nozzle.
shots.narration: 调好张力，送丝到出嘴。

shots.scene: 切割机喷嘴发红热，高温标志
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the copper nozzle on the cutting head glowing warm, with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 刚加工完，喷嘴可能很烫。

shots.scene: 戴耐热手套拧下喷嘴，用布擦
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a thick leather heat-resistant glove unscrews the nozzle and wipes it with a cloth.
shots.narration: 戴耐热手套拧下来，擦干净。

shots.scene: 戴手套拉出底板，沙和熔渣倒进盒子
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands pull out the base tray and pour sand and slag into a plastic box.
shots.narration: 拉出底板，倒出沙和熔渣。

shots.scene: 酒精无尘布擦底板，再铺新沙
shots.prompt_en: A lint-free cloth wipes the empty base tray, then fresh sand is poured in and spread evenly. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 必要时擦净底板，再加沙推回。

shots.scene: 清洁剂喷在布上，再擦摄像头
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle sprays cleaner onto a lint-free cloth, which then wipes a small camera lens inside the machine.
shots.narration: 清洁剂喷在布上，再擦摄像头。

shots.scene: 擦拭机内顶部的灯条
shots.prompt_en: A hand with a lint-free cloth wipes a long LED strip light at the top inside the machine.
shots.narration: 擦净机内的灯条。

shots.scene: 打开的防护盖，擦观察窗内侧
shots.prompt_en: The lid of the cutting machine is open and a hand wipes the inside of the tinted viewing window.
shots.narration: 防护盖观察窗，里外都要擦。

shots.scene: 擦观察窗外侧，窗面透亮
shots.prompt_en: A hand wipes the outside of the tinted viewing window until it is clear. No other people.
shots.narration: 窗面干净，才能看清机内情况。

shots.scene: 擦拭夹具导轨和防尘板
shots.prompt_en: A hand with a cloth wipes the fixture rail and the dustproof plate along the edge of the cutting bed.
shots.narration: 夹具导轨和防尘板，擦去灰渣。

shots.scene: 栅条齿上结满熔渣，手戴手套取出
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand lifts a metal slat whose teeth are crusted with slag out of the cutting bed.
shots.narration: 栅条上结满熔渣，取出来清理。

shots.scene: 老李戴面罩、护目镜和皮手套，用带护罩的角磨机打磨固定好的栅条
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing a face shield over safety goggles and leather gloves grinds slag off a slat clamped in a bench vise with a guarded angle grinder; sparks fly toward a cleared floor.
shots.narration: 磨掉熔渣，齿口恢复平整。

shots.scene: 干净的栅条放回槽里
shots.prompt_en: Clean slats with smooth teeth are placed back into the slots of the cutting bed. No people.
shots.narration: 清理好的栅条装回去。

shots.scene: 从机背取下排风扇组件，拔开插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the exhaust fan box from the back of the machine and unplugs its connector.
shots.narration: 取下排风扇，拔开插头。

shots.scene: 拆螺丝，取下外壳和网罩
shots.prompt_en: On a table, hands remove screws, lift off the fan housing and take off the wire guard.
shots.narration: 拆螺丝，取下外壳和网罩。

shots.scene: 刷子刷扇叶和框里的积尘，戴口罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing a dust mask brushes dust off the fan blades and frame with a soft brush.
shots.narration: 用刷子刷掉扇叶上的积尘。

shots.scene: 用布擦净扇叶
shots.prompt_en: A cloth wipes each fan blade clean. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 再用布擦干净。

shots.scene: 复装网罩、外壳，接线装回机器
shots.prompt_en: The fan, guard and housing are reassembled, the connector is plugged back in and the box is pressed onto the machine.
shots.narration: 按原样装好，接线装回。

shots.scene: 拆下后板和两侧侧板，侧板上标着左右
shots.prompt_en: The back panel and the side panels of the cutting machine are removed; the side panels have blank left and right marks.
shots.narration: 拆下后板和左右侧板。

shots.scene: 擦拭底板滑轨
shots.prompt_en: A hand with a cloth wipes the slide rails that carry the base tray. No other people.
shots.narration: 擦净底板滑轨，推拉才顺。

shots.scene: 关掉两台设备电源，拔钥匙，拔下电源插头
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off both machines, removes the key and unplugs the power cable from the socket.
shots.narration: 维护前，关机、拔钥匙、断电源。

shots.scene: 门口挂上维修中警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance warning tag hangs on the machine's power switch and a sign stands at the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 挂上维修牌，防止别人误开机。

shots.scene: 温度计图标下降，等喷嘴冷却
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a thermometer dropping next to the nozzle and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 高温部件先冷却，再动手。

shots.scene: 小瓶酒精、清洁剂，旁边火焰图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A small closed bottle of alcohol and a spray cleaner, next to a flame icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精和清洁剂易燃，少量取用。

shots.scene: 开窗通风，用过的布放进带盖金属桶
shots.prompt_en: A window is opened for ventilation and used cloths are dropped into a closed metal bin. No people besides a hand.
shots.narration: 通风，远离热源，废布放带盖桶。

shots.scene: 角磨机使用防护图标：面罩、护目镜、手套、护罩
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a face shield, safety goggles, leather gloves and an angle grinder with its guard highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用角磨机，要戴护目镜和面罩。

shots.scene: 工件用台钳夹紧，火花方向没有可燃物
shots.prompt_en: A slat is clamped firmly in a bench vise; the spark direction points to a cleared floor with no boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 工件夹牢，火花朝向空地。

shots.scene: 没戴护目镜打磨的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a person grinding metal without eye protection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电动工具要培训后才能用。

shots.scene: 倒沙时扬起灰尘，小研戴口罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing a dust mask pours old sand from the tray; a small dust cloud rises.
shots.narration: 倒沙、刷灰会扬尘，戴好口罩。

shots.scene: 熔渣和废沙装进有标签的废料桶
shots.prompt_en: Slag and used sand go into a closed waste bin with a blank label. No people besides a hand.
shots.narration: 废渣按学校规定分类处置。

shots.scene: 设备旁贴着空白维护清单，部分部件标着禁止拆
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance checklist beside the machine; the laser source box and power module carry a do not open sign. No people.
shots.narration: 能拆哪些部件，按说明书和规定。

shots.scene: 老李把钥匙和密码信封锁进柜子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer locks a key and an envelope marked with a padlock icon into a small cabinet.
shots.narration: 管理员密码专人管，默认密码要改。

shots.scene: 小研在维护记录本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank maintenance logbook.
shots.narration: 每次保养都写进记录。

shots.scene: 装回排风扇后开机，烟雾被顺利抽走
shots.prompt_en: After reassembly, the exhaust fan runs and a thin test smoke is drawn smoothly out of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 装回后先试排风，正常再加工。

shots.scene: 阿杰手指割伤，小研拿急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small cut on his finger; the female graduate student opens a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 割伤、烫伤，先做简单处理。

shots.scene: 眼睛进异物，到洗眼器冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eye at an eyewash station with the female graduate student beside him.
shots.narration: 铁屑进眼，冲洗后马上就医。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，三个报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her icons of a lab door, a college building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 严重的拨打120，并逐级报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现镜片、红点、焊丝盘图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a lens, a red dot and a wire spool.
shots.narration: 焊机：镜片洁净，红光对准，配件匹配。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现喷嘴、底板、栅条、风扇图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a nozzle, a base tray, a slat and a fan.
shots.narration: 切割机：喷嘴底板栅条风扇，定期清。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现插头、手套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of an unplugged power plug, gloves and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 先断电冷却，防护戴好，再保养。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老李在擦得发亮的设备前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer wave goodbye in front of the clean, shiny machines.
shots.narration: 勤保养，安全用，下次见！
